# Decisions

What is settled, what is still open, and who decides. Update this file when a decision lands, and record the date.

The Source column says where each rule comes from:

- **Matteo:** his own words or his pick in the tone check (29 Oct 2026).
- **Inferred:** our reading of his answers or edits. Follow it, but it can change when he says otherwise.
- **House:** a brand or compliance rule we set. He has not objected to it.

## Settled

| Date | Decision | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 29 Oct 2026 | Doefin in one line: "Trade and hedge Bitcoin hashrate exposure through markets on mining difficulty." Replaces "Markets for Bitcoin mining difficulty." | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | "Trade" is the word for what users do ("Trade and hedge…", "Place a trade"). "Take a position" is for explaining how a market works. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Hashrate is the economic exposure; difficulty decides the contract outcome. Keep the distinction clear without repeating the full explanation in every section. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | "Hedge" is one of the words to use. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Where there is room, say what a hedge does not cover. Never say a named miner or fund uses Doefin unless it is true and they agreed. Replaces "say miners hedge only when you can name them". | Inferred, from E17, E20 and E36 |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Customer copy says "shares", explained once as position tokens. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | No contractions anywhere: "I am", "you are", "there is", "do not". Replaces "contractions are fine". | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | The app button says "Enter app". | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | British spelling, confirmed. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Difficulty figures have no space before the T: 140.58T. Other units keep the space: 1.2 ZH/s, 0.25 BTC. | Matteo for T; house for other units, as in his posts |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Emoji and exclamation marks are fine on social when they fit. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | No emoji or exclamation marks on the website, in the app, in email or in documents. No hashtags anywhere. | House |
| 29 Oct 2026 | LinkedIn posts run up to 250 words when they explain an argument. Short updates of about 100 words are preferred. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | The risk line is "You can lose the full amount paid for a position." The website footer, in his words: the one-liner, then "For professional investors. You can lose the full amount paid for a position. Nothing here is investment advice." | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Never "guaranteed profit", "risk-free", "protect all revenues" or "native yield". Never imply that a position directly delivers hashrate or covers every mining risk. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Matteo reviews these before they are published: new product claims, changes to settlement or collateral wording, financial examples, performance claims, and legal or access language. Routine content uses the agreed wording. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Peers and competitors are named only in relevant, factual comparisons supported by current evidence, never implying endorsement or affiliation. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | The newsletter is signed Doefin for company updates. A piece that gives a personal view names its author. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Forecasts are evaluated with the same method, and material misses and corrections are made visible. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Posts can show live prices from the app, if possible as dated, time-stamped screenshots with the market and quote units visible. Never imply that a quote guarantees execution, liquidity or a return. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Investor and partner decks use the same standards for evidence, product mechanics and risk claims. Depth and emphasis change with the audience. | Matteo |
| 29 Oct 2026 | The rules in `content-types.md`, with his additions. Rules he left blank stand as drafted. | Matteo, house for the blank rows |
| 29 Oct 2026 | Raffaella Tenconi is not part of Doefin. Older team documents and the old site name this person as regulatory adviser and approver by mistake. Never name them as part of the team or as an approver. | Reza |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Keep the existing navy (`ink`, #0A0F1C) and Doefin Blue (#3475FE). One accent per screen. Flat colour: the blue-to-purple gradient and the glows are retired. | House |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Orange (#F05122) means loss or error only, never decoration. | House |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Buttons use #2C63D8, because white text on #3475FE is only 4.1:1. | House |
| 27 Oct 2026 | A light theme exists for documents, decks and print. Dark is the default everywhere else. | House |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Do not use "hashrate derivatives" or "prediction market" in new copy. | House |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Doefin is registered in Port Louis, Mauritius. It is never described as a UK company. | Reza |
| 27 Oct 2026 | Manrope is the only typeface. Sentence case for headings, buttons and titles. | House |
| 27 Oct 2026 | The writing follows Matteo's own voice and thinking (`voice.md`, `matteo/thinking.md`, `matteo/edits.md`, `voice-samples.md`). | House |

| Yes and No. He wrote "avoid using the YES/NO position, but favour saying for example 'buy a position that pays out if difficulty is above X'". He also wrote "buy Yes or No shares" (E07) and "take Yes or No positions" (E23). | Never "YES/NO position" in capitals. In marketing copy, describe the position. | The disclaimer: "Doefin is for professional investors only. You can lose the full amount paid for a position. Nothing here is investment advice."
